title: Understanding N-gram Limitations
text: Consider how N-grams treat sequences of letters. What happens when you have segments that don't align with the natural structure of the data?

title: Non-Consecutive Segments
text: Think about how N-grams might mistakenly group non-consecutive letters together. How could this affect the interpretation of the data?

title: Meaningless Segments
text: Segments with $$1$$ or $$2$$ letters don't have biological meaning in DNA. How does this impact the usefulness of N-grams?

title: Overlapping Segments
text: Consider how overlapping segments might be created by N-grams. What issues could arise from this?

title: Wrap-Around Segments
text: DNA sequences don't wrap around, but N-grams might treat them as if they do. What problems could this cause?
